models_evaluated: retrieval-augmented ChatGPT-4.0 custom GPT grounded in IUGA leaflets

links.outcome: QAMAI total quality score of responses, retrieval-augmented vs standard ChatGPT, rated by urogynecologists
links.effect: Median total QAMAI 22 (IQR 19-25) vs 16 (IQR 13-18), p<0.01; sensitivity analysis excluding Sources 18 vs 14.5, p<0.01; raters preferred RAG in 81% of responses.
links.quote: The median total QAMAI score was 22 (interquartile range [IQR] 19–25) for the retrieval-augmented model, compared with 16 (IQR 13–18) for the standard model ( p < 0.01; Table 2 ), representing a shift from “fair” to “good” quality based on established QAMAI score thresholds.

links.outcome: Response quality of RAG model using a defined, vetted IUGA leaflet corpus versus standard model
links.effect: RAG model grounded in IUGA leaflets outperformed standard model in all six QAMAI domains; total 22 vs 16, p<0.01.
links.quote: The retrieval-augmented model outperformed the standard model across all six QAMAI domains, with the largest difference observed in the Sources domain (5 [IQR 4–5] vs 2 [IQR 1–2.5], p < 0.01).

openai.sample_unit: model responses to 10 patient questions, rated by 6 urogynecologists

links.effect: RAG total QAMAI 22 (IQR 19–25) vs standard 16 (IQR 13–18), p < 0.01.
links.quote: The median total QAMAI score was 22 (interquartile range [IQR] 19–25) for the retrieval-augmented model, compared with 16 (IQR 13–18) for the standard model ( p < 0.01; Table 2 ), representing a shift from “fair” to “good” quality based on established QAMAI score thresholds.
The retrieval-augmented model outperformed the standard model across all six QAMAI domains, with the largest difference observed in the Sources domain (5 [IQR 4–5] vs 2 [IQR 1–2.5], p < 0.01).

links.effect: Total QAMAI 22 (IQR 19–25) vs 16 (IQR 13–18), p < 0.01; without References 18 vs 14.5, p < 0.01.
links.quote: Grounding AI tools in vetted patient education materials significantly improved the quality of ChatGPT-generated responses in urogynecology.
All responses were additionally screened for potentially harmful, biased, or misleading content, and none was identified.
